name: Clip-path blob

image.note: optional; when present the blob carries a .u-aspect-1x1 > img.u-img-cover (object-fit: CONTAIN)

notes: The shape vocabulary is CLOSED at 7 ids. No route adds path data — routes recombine the same 7 with different fills, images and rotations.
clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox", so the path is resolution-independent and the div just needs a 1:1 box.
